review_notes: Bangladeshi nationals are listed in Annex I of Regulation (EU) 2018/1806 and therefore require a visa for short stays in the Schengen area, subject to limited legal exemptions. This record describes the common Schengen short-stay framework only: up to 90 days in any 180-day period; single or multiple entry as granted; adult standard fee EUR 90 (children aged 6–12 EUR 45); normal processing 15 calendar days, extendable up to 45 days; application no earlier than 6 months and normally at least 15 days before travel. Apply to the competent consulate of the main destination; where multiple Schengen states are visited, use the state of longest stay, or the first state if stays are equal. For Bangladesh residents, the competent mission and any representation arrangement differ by destination. Use the EEAS Bangladesh list and the destination mission's current instructions to identify the correct embassy and authorised visa centre. Do not assume a single VFS channel for all states. Additional service-provider fees may apply. The passport validity rule is at least 3 months after intended departure and passport issued within the previous 10 years. Travel medical insurance is required; consulates may request additional documents. Airport-transit visa rules are separate and destination-state-specific. This is not a country-specific appointment, checklist, or service-fee confirmation; verify those with the relevant mission before applying. Official sources checked 2026-11-14.

This record describes the common Schengen short-stay framework only: up to 90 days in any 180-day period; single or multiple entry as granted; adult standard fee EUR 90 (children aged 6–12 EUR 45); normal processing 15 calendar days, extendable up to 45 days; application no earlier than 6 months and normally at least 15 days before travel. Apply to the competent consulate of the main destination; where multiple Schengen states are visited, use the state of longest stay, or the first state if stays are equal. For Bangladesh residents, the competent mission and any representation arrangement differ by destination. Use the EEAS Bangladesh list and the destination mission's current instructions to identify the correct embassy and authorised visa centre. Do not assume a single VFS channel for all states. Additional service-provider fees may apply. The passport validity rule is at least 3 months after intended departure and passport issued within the previous 10 years. Travel medical insurance is required; consulates may request additional documents. Airport-transit visa rules are separate and destination-state-specific. This is not a country-specific appointment, checklist, or service-fee confirmation; verify those with the relevant mission before applying. Official sources checked 2026-11-14.

maximum_permitted_stay: Up to 90 days in any 180-day period, subject to the visa validity and authorised duration of stay.
entry_count: Single or multiple entry, as granted.
passport_validity_rule: Passport issued within the previous 10 years and valid for at least 3 months after the intended departure from the Schengen area.
blank_passport_pages_rule: Check the competent consulate's current checklist; no single common blank-page count is stated in the general Commission guidance.
return_ticket_rule: Provide itinerary and evidence supporting intended return or onward departure; exact evidence depends on the consulate's checklist.
proof_of_funds_rule: Evidence of sufficient financial means for the intended stay; amounts and acceptable evidence may vary by destination state.
accommodation_rule: Evidence of accommodation for the intended stay; exact acceptable evidence depends on the consulate's checklist.
travel_insurance_rule: Mandatory travel medical insurance covering emergency medical care, hospitalisation and repatriation.
yellow_fever_or_health_rule: Follow current public-health and entry rules; no general tourist vaccination certificate identified in the common short-stay visa checklist.
transit_rule: Airport-transit visa (Type A) is separate from a Type C visa; requirement depends on nationality, airport, route and destination-state rules. Check the relevant state's official transit guidance.
application_channel: Apply through the competent Schengen-state embassy/consulate or its officially authorised external service provider in Bangladesh. Determine the main destination by longest stay; if equal stays, apply to the first country visited. Use the EEAS Bangladesh list of Schengen visa-issuing embassies and the destination mission's current instructions; representation and appointment channels vary by country.
application_fee: EUR 90 for adults; EUR 45 for children aged 6–12. Exemptions may apply. External service-provider fee may be additional.
processing_time: Normally 15 calendar days; may extend to 45 days. Appointment waiting time is separate.
